jobs.title: Faculty Position in Water Data Science
jobs.description:
Department:
MCC Civil & Environmental Engg

Tenure-Track Assistant or Associate Professor in
Water Data Science

The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Northwestern University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track faculty position in the broad area of artificial intelligence and data science for water. The successful candidate is expected to build and sustain a world-class research program in intelligent, adaptive, and autonomous water technologies for water-resilient communities, integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning into the design, optimization, and security of next-generation water systems. Candidates working on all aspects of this problem are welcome to apply, including AI-enabled water treatment technologies, optimization of water treatment processes and systems, water resources data analysis and planning, water reuse and resource recovery, and links between water quality and public health. Research approaches can include theoretical, computational, and experimental methods. Applicants must hold a Ph.D. or be near completion of their doctoral studies with demonstrated potential to develop an advanced research and education program. The faculty appointment could be made at the level of either assistant professor or associate professor.

Northwestern University is a leading R1 university with a number of highly ranked schools and departments that provide exceptional opportunities for collaboration across a wide range of disciplines. The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering is ranked 13 th in the US, and the McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science is ranked 16 th . The successful candidate is expected to develop collaborations leveraging Northwestern’s robust research centers and institutes, including the Northwestern Center for Water , Center for Engineering Sustainability & Resilience , Trienens Institute for Sustainability and Energy , Northwestern Institute on Complex Systems , and substantial new investments in the Northwestern Network for Collaborative Intelligence and the Thriving Planet Institute . Northwestern is located in Evanston, Illinois, on the shore of Lake Michigan, just outside the city of Chicago, providing excellent opportunities to engage in water research with high-tech industry and a variety of governmental agencies. Northwestern is a founding member of a regional water hub Current Innovation and the NSF Great Lakes ReNEW Water Innovation Engine , providing a network of collaborators and ongoing funding to support water research.

Application instructions:
Candidates should submit 1) a cover letter, 2) curriculum vitae, 3) statement of research, 4) statement of teaching, and 5) the names and contact information for three to five references. In the cover letter, candidates should summarize their qualifications in developing research and education programs in artificial intelligence and data science for water. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. To receive full consideration, all materials should be received by December 1, 2026
. Application materials must be uploaded to https://www.mccormick.northwestern.edu/civil-environmental/careers.html General inquiries can be sent to the Search Committee Chair at CEEcareers@northwestern.edu

Compensation
: The expected base pay range for this position at the Assistant Professor level is $133,000 – $143,000 and at the Associate Professor level is $145,000 – $158,000. This base pay range is for a nine-month academic appointment, does not include summer salary, and is subject to negotiation. Sponsorship for an H-1B visa may be available for qualified candidates, subject to institutional policies and applicable immigration regulations.

Northwestern University has provided a pay range representing its good faith estimate of what the university reasonably expects to pay for the position. The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate, including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.

Benefits

At Northwestern, we are proud to provide meaningful and competitive benefits. The available benefits package for this position will include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid medical/sick and parental leave; tuition benefits for the employee and dependents; pre-tax and flex spending accounts for commuting and dependent care; generous retirement savings options; and wellness programs. For a comprehensive overview of available benefits, including eligibility details, visit us at Northwestern Benefits to learn more.

Please read ALL instructions and make preparations before proceeding to the application page:

Applications will only be accepted via online submission (see link below).
Please prepare all documents in advance as Adobe PDF files, and please be sure all information is entered correctly and accurately (especially names and email addresses), as there will be no opportunity for online revision after your application has been submitted.
Please also prepare a list of names and email addresses for your external academic references; your references will be contacted directly by the online system and invited to upload their letters on your behalf.
All required fields in the application form are marked with an asterisk and must be filled before clicking the “Submit” button.
Be aware that incomplete applications cannot be saved.

Applications accepted here: Apply for Job

View Northwestern’s non-discrimination statement . Job applicants who wish to request an accommodation in the application or hiring process should contact the Office of Civil Rights and Title IX Compliance. View additional information on the accommodations process .

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Data Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title:
AI Data Engineer

Location:
100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type:
Full-time, Direct W2

Salary Range:
$80,000–$100,000 Annually

Experience Required:
6+ years

Sponsorship:
U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an AI Data Engineer to build and operate the large-scale data systems that power modern AI training and evaluation pipelines. The role combines deep data engineering expertise with a strong understanding of AI workloads, focusing on ingestion, transformation, quality assurance, lineage, and high-throughput delivery of data to training jobs across diverse modalities. The ideal candidate has experience operating petabyte-scale data systems, strong software engineering fundamentals, and clear understanding of how data infrastructure choices propagate into model quality and training efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Six or more years of data engineering experience, with significant work supporting ML or AI workloads
Strong proficiency in Python and at least one JVM or systems language
Deep experience with modern data processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or Beam
Hands-on experience operating petabyte-scale storage and pipeline systems
Strong understanding of distributed systems, data modeling, and storage formats
Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, and reproducibility for ML workflows
Familiarity with high-throughput data loading for accelerator-based training
Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multimodal datasets at large scale
Familiarity with data quality tooling and dataset evaluation methodology
Exposure to privacy-preserving data systems and regulated data handling
Open-source contributions to data infrastructure projects
Experience supporting frontier model training pipelines

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to hilda@bvteck.com. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist I
jobs.description:
Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Job Description

The Global Research, Informatics & Platform Solutions team within the Information Research (IR) Division works with internal clients to provide data management and decision support tools to optimize the efficiency and efficacy of research and development at AbbVie. Under leadership guidance, this role supports multiple areas within Research & Discovery to build visualizations, transform data, capture data, and support end users. The role also participates in data flow documentation and general requirement gathering. This is a cross-functional role, working directly with discovery scientists and technology stakeholders to optimize data capture, visualization, and decision-making.

Responsibilities:

Communicate – Ability to communicate with scientific individuals. from Discovery teams to understand existing workflows and data flow & gather requirements.
Build – Design and implement technology solutions that integrate, visualize, and analyze complex multi-platform data, including omics, biomarkers, & preclinical safety.
Integrate – Understand the value in capturing data properly and integrating data sets.
Support – Work directly with scientists to support their dashboarding or technical needs.
Technical Proficiency – Demonstrate high proficiency in python, SQL, & other technologies for data storage, transfer, integration, visualization, and analytics.
Adaptability – Ability to work on multiple, sometimes very different, projects at one time.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree.
Background in life sciences, biology, or equivalent required.
Dedicated team player who can interface with discovery scientists and IT partners.
Strong programming proficiency in Python (and possibly other modern languages) and strong familiarity with data visualization and pipelining tools such as Spotfire, or equivalent
Understanding of software development process and familiarity with CI/CD tools.
Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration & training, including documenting and presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders: outstanding interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
Familiarity with modern data science and AI techniques & interest in further developing technical skills and scientific knowledge.
Ability to work independently, multitask, and work within timelines.
A self-motivated learner and thinker with a hands-on approach.

Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer (Agents & Automation)
jobs.description:
About One Intelligence

Multifamily is one of the largest asset classes in America: trillions of dollars of apartment buildings, run every day by a patchwork of software, spreadsheets and people on site. Every one of those buildings has a body. None has ever had a brain. We're building it. One Intelligence, developed by The One Companies, is the brain of the physical real estate asset, built to fully automate multifamily operations, from the leasing office to the boiler room. Today, 160 units run on it. A team of 1.5 people grew the platform 93.5x in 273 days. Now we're scaling.

Most software and SaaS companies in real estate give owners and operators a fragmented experience: they need multiple platforms just to deliver Knowledge Work, like leasing, renewals, accounting and investor relations. And none has yet taken the power of AI in Knowledge Work and solved for Physical Work: maintenance, unit turns, repairs and smart-building systems.

We have one single intelligence system to do it all.

We're real estate owners and operators, so we build on live properties, not in a lab or a back office. Every feature is used by our team before it reaches a client.

The role

You'll be one of the first engineers. Our core operating platform is already live. You'll take it to the next level of automation, own big parts of it end to end, ship weekly, and work directly with our founder, John Gagliardo, and the people who use it every day.

What you'll do

- Make our agents run the building. Take One Force, Maya and Osmo from assisting people to running renewals, move-ins and move-outs, collections and reporting on their own, with people stepping in only on exceptions.
- Close the loop on Physical Work. Sensor alerts become work orders, and the right vendor is matched, dispatched, scheduled and verified, automatically.
- Build automations every owner can shape. Let each client set its own policies, approval limits and playbooks, so the platform adapts to how they run their buildings, not the other way around.
- Scale from one portfolio to many. Repeatable client setup, safe upgrades, durable job execution and a data history the agents can trust.
- Lay the groundwork for physical agents. Design the systems that will let today's virtual agents act in the building itself.
- Decide where AI adds value and where plain, predictable code is better.

What we're looking for

- 4+ years building and shipping production software, full stack in TypeScript, React, Node.js and PostgreSQL
- AI-native, required: you build with AI coding tools every day and have shipped LLM agents to production (prompting, tool use, evaluation, guardrails)
- Speed with judgment: you ship fast and know what must not break (money, leases, resident data)
- Comfort with ambiguity and ownership; you'd rather build than wait for a spec
- Bonus: making systems reliable at scale; hardware, IoT or robotics; proptech, fintech or operations software

Stack

TypeScript end to end: React, Vite and Tailwind on the front; Node.js and Express on the back; PostgreSQL with Drizzle. AI runs on OpenAI and Anthropic models through our own agent orchestration, with Retell for voice and SMS, Stripe for payments, and IoT sensors for smart-building data.

Your first six months

1. A policy-governed agent platform. Extend One Force with typed tools, bounded authority, audit trails and measurable evaluations.
2. Closed-loop maintenance automation. Connect resident requests and sensors to dispatch, scheduling, vendor completion and escalation.
3. Autonomous renewals. Connect pricing, offers, concessions, reminders, signing and exceptions, with clear financial controls.
4. Custom automations. Let each client set its own policies, approval limits and playbooks for how the agents work.
5. Broader agent coverage. Extend the agents into collections, turnovers, vendor coordination and reporting.

Where this goes

Over the next 2 to 7 years, we're turning our virtual agents into physical agents: agents that don't just coordinate Physical Work, but carry it out in the building. We're building both the brain and the physical capability of the asset, solving Knowledge Work and Physical Work as one. The systems you build now are the foundation for that.

Location:
Chicago.

Compensation:
$170K-$220K base, plus 0.5%-2% founding equity that vests over time. Full relocation to Chicago.

What this role isn't

We operate like a speedboat, not a cargo ship. There are no layers of process, no long roadmaps handed down, and no waiting for approvals. You'll make calls, ship fast and change course quickly. If you want a big-company role with a narrow lane, this isn't it.

How to apply

Send us your three most impressive builds (links, GitHub, demos or short videos) plus your resume. If there's a fit, you'll have a short call with John, then a paid build on a real One Intelligence workflow.
